title: oreogrammitis caespitosa
intro: Oreogrammitis caespitosa, commonly known as the bushy fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oreogrammitis caespitosa include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an analgesic. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
